ei.title: Depression as a Disorder of Consciousness
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Conventional medicine has long believed that depression is caused by an imbalance of neurotransmitters in the brain. However, there is a major problem with this explanation. This is because the imbalance of substances in the brain is a consequence of depression, not its cause. In other words, depression causes a decrease in brain substances such as serotonin and noradrenaline, not a decrease in brain substances causes depression. In this revised cause-and-effect, the key is to reframe depression as a problem of consciousness. Our consciousness is a more fundamental entity that goes beyond the functioning of the brain. The brain is no more than an organ of consciousness. If it is not consciousness itself, then the root cause of depression is also a distortion of our state of consciousness: a consciousness that has lost its sense of self and the meaning of life. Such a disease of consciousness may manifest itself in the form of depression.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a part of the body that has a particular function, such as the heart or the brain"

det.korean: organ=기관: 심장이나 뇌처럼 특정 기능을 하는 신체의 한 부분
det.analysis:
❌ ① entity: '실체'는 신체 기관을 특정하지 않음
❌ ② substance: '물질'은 신체의 한 부분이 아님
❌ ③ consequence: '결과'는 신체 기관과 무관
✅ ④ organ: '기관'은 심장·뇌처럼 특정 기능을 하는 신체의 한 부분으로 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: organ = (신체) 기관. a part of the body with a function이 핵심

questions.passage: Conventional medicine has long believed that depression is __________ (cause) by an imbalance of neurotransmitters in the brain. However, there is a major problem with this explanation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 수동태 be + 과거분사: depression is caused by ~ (우울증이 유발되다)
det.analysis: 'depression is __________ (cause) by an imbalance'에서 우울증이 불균형에 의해 '유발되는' 수동 관계이므로 수동태(be + 과거분사)가 필요하다. cause의 과거분사는 caused. cause → caused.
det.tip: 수동태 be + 과거분사. is caused by = ~에 의해 유발되다

questions.passage: Our consciousness is a more fundamental entity that __________ (go) beyond the functioning of the brain. The brain is no more than an organ of consciousness. If it is not consciousness itself, then the root cause of depression is also a distortion of our state of consciousness: a consciousness that has lost its sense of self and the meaning of life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 주격 관계대명사절의 수 일치: 선행사 entity(단수)이므로 단수 동사 goes
det.analysis: 'a more fundamental entity that __________ (go) beyond'에서 주격 관계대명사 that의 선행사는 entity(단수)이므로 관계사절 동사도 단수여야 한다. go의 3인칭 단수형은 goes. go → goes.
det.tip: 주격 관계대명사절 동사는 선행사에 수 일치. entity that goes

questions.passage: Conventional medicine has long believed that depression is caused by an imbalance of neurotransmitters in the brain. However, there is a major problem with this explanation. This is because the imbalance of substances in the brain is __________, not its cause. In other words, depression causes a decrease in brain substances such as serotonin and noradrenaline, not a decrease in brain substances causes depression. In this revised cause-and-effect, the key is to reframe depression as a problem of consciousness. Our consciousness is a more fundamental entity that goes beyond the functioning of the brain. The brain is no more than an organ of consciousness. If it is not consciousness itself, then the root cause of depression is also a distortion of our state of consciousness: a consciousness that has lost its sense of self and the meaning of life. Such a disease of consciousness may manifest itself in the form of depression.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: a consequence of depression=우울증의 결과 — 뇌 물질 불균형의 정체
det.analysis:
✅ ① a consequence of depression: 원문 일치. 뇌 물질의 불균형은 우울증의 결과이지 원인이 아니다 ←정답
❌ ② the true cause of depression: 본문은 불균형이 '원인이 아니다'라고 명시 — 반대
❌ ③ an effective cure for depression: '치료법'은 본문 근거 없음
❌ ④ a symptom unrelated to depression: '우울증과 무관한 증상'은 결과라는 설명과 모순
det.tip: the imbalance ~ is a consequence of depression, not its cause

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: goes beyond the functioning of the brain=뇌의 기능을 넘어선다 — 의식이 더 근본적인 실체인 이유
det.analysis:
❌ ① depends entirely on the brain(전적으로 뇌에 의존한다): 의식이 뇌를 넘어선다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ② is produced only by neurotransmitters(신경전달물질로만 생성된다): 뇌를 넘어선다는 맥락과 반대
✅ ③ goes beyond the functioning of the brain: 원문 일치. 의식은 뇌의 기능을 넘어서는 더 근본적인 실체이다 ←정답
❌ ④ disappears when the brain is damaged(뇌가 손상되면 사라진다): 의식이 뇌보다 근본적이라는 글과 반대
det.tip: a more fundamental entity that goes beyond the functioning of the brain
